keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Keep jobs whose title, department or team contains any of these. Leave empty for all jobs.

excludeKeywords.title: Exclude keywords
excludeKeywords.description: Drop jobs whose title contains any of these, for example intern or director.

cities.title: Cities
cities.description: Indian cities to keep, for example Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune. Old spellings such as Bangalore and Gurgaon are understood. Leave empty for all of India.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days. 0 means no limit.

onlyNew.title: Only jobs new since the last run
onlyNew.description: Remembers what it already returned, so a scheduled run gives you only fresh postings. You pay only for new jobs.

stateKey.title: Feed name
stateKey.description: Used with 'only new'. Give each separate feed its own name so they do not share memory.

maxItems.title: Maximum jobs
maxItems.description: Stop after this many jobs. 0 means no limit.

searchDescription.title: Also search keywords in the description

indiaOnly.title: India jobs only
indiaOnly.description: Turn off to get every open job at the listed companies, worldwide.

includeDefaultCompanies.title: Use the built-in company list
includeDefaultCompanies.description: The built-in list covers companies verified to be hiring in India.

companies.title: Extra companies
companies.description: Add your own boards as ats:token, for example greenhouse:stripe, lever:cred, ashby:notion or smartrecruiters:BoschGroup. The token is the last part of the company's job board address.
